scope: Public data extraction and reproducible encoding only. Source hashes are not hypotheses or proof premises in Lean.
representation: Balanced binary literal trees with kernel-reducible natural/integer leaves. This avoids linear kernel lookup through Array list representations.

T127_T631.input: b_sequences, four complete signed one-hot rows
T127_T631.code_at_position_x: 2*channel + negative_bit, where channel is the unique nonzero row and negative_bit=1 for -1
T127_T631.decoding: Data.unitCode recovers the four integer rows
T127_T631.formal_checks: Bounds, signed one-hot shape and all periodic correlations are checked on the literal codes; generic soundness bridges to rational ZMod rows.

Williamson27.formal_checks: Every sign, row symmetry, complete periodic summed Gram, matrix norm and amicability.

Spence5.input: starters.literal_first_rows_pm in the family source certificate
Spence5.q61_q101_q121: The origin records retain the signed channel permutations of the underlying Williamson rows. The resulting literal rows are checked directly in Lean.
Spence5.formal_checks: Sign, symmetry, commuting regular matrices, minus norm4I and plus norm4qI.

Paley5.q121_additive_group: ZMod11 × ZMod11; index a+11*b; group subtraction is componentwise, not cyclic modulo121.
Paley5.formal_checks: Integer character-row identities are transported to the required rational Paley matrices.

Unreal13.input: Raw exponents plus unreal_row_phase_shifts and unreal_column_phase_shifts, modulo6.
Unreal13.formal_checks: All signs, A*B^T=B*A^T and A*A^T+3B*B^T=52I are proved for the literal matrices over integers, then transported to rationals.

formal_scope: The Lean existence theorems concern the explicitly defined literal constructions. Formal equality with the original packed H7572 binary is not claimed.

numerical_certificate_layout.T127: Direct kernel reduction of all127 periodic shifts using the balanced literal lookup.

T631.method: Each closed range is proved with decide +kernel. A generic pointwise coverage lemma recombines all32 ranges; explicit arguments avoid evaluating the entire closed checker during assembly.
